rationale: The approved core-boundary cleanup transfers seven adapter-owned command-risk regexes into one core-owned command matcher, removing six regex sites across the solution. Removing redundant risk-phrase wrappers also exposes one existing phrase check to the inventory's direct-call scanner. These two precisely scoped core matcher sites centralize existing semantics rather than broaden the recognized domain. Three unused semantic detectors are removed; modules, phrase literals, dependency fan-out, and parsing ownership do not grow, and total semantic lines decrease. The hard matcher budget is 595; all other budgets remain unchanged. Reassess this digest-bound allowance after merge into origin/main.
